lines.zh: 我的脚趾黏住叶面，走得很稳。
lines.en: My toes stick to the leaf; my steps are sure.

lines.zh: 我的皮肤在湿叶上很亮。
lines.en: My skin shines on the wet leaves.
I move along the moss.
My toes have pads.

lines.zh: 我爬上湿石，越过小水洼。
lines.en: I climb a wet stone and cross a small puddle.

lines.zh: 我跳过一段湿苔，没出声。
lines.en: I hop over wet moss without a sound.
My body is two fingers long.
I hide under a fern leaf.

lines.zh: 我一动不动地待着，然后一跳。
lines.en: I hold still, then hop.
I move through the leaf litter.

lines.zh: 我的颜色很显眼，我不在乎。
lines.en: My colors stand out. I don't mind.
I hop over a fallen vine.
I slide down a leaf.
My throat keeps pulsing.
I land on damp mud.
I slip into a rock crevice.
I go around a large insect.
I hop low to the ground.
I crouch on a leaf, very still.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛鼓着，一直在看。
lines.en: My eyes bulge and keep watching.
There's a sheen of moisture on my skin.

lines.zh: 一只小虫从我面前爬过。
lines.en: A small insect crawls past.
I wait for a raindrop to fall.

lines.zh: 我的颜色在湿叶上发亮。
lines.en: My colors shine on the wet leaf.
Damp and dark. Good.
I tuck my legs under me.

lines.zh: 我的颜色在暗处更醒目。
lines.en: My colors stand out more in the dark.
My eyes open and shut.
I listen to the forest dripping.

lines.zh: 我把吸盘贴在叶面上，不动。
lines.en: I stick my toe pads to the leaf and hold still.
You're bigger than the whole tree.
Crouch, and only then will I move.
Don't touch my colors.
I retreat hop by hop.
You crouch, and the ground darkens.
I don't like big things.

lines.zh: 我躲在叶子后面，露出半只眼。
lines.en: I hide behind a leaf, half an eye showing.
You carry no dampness.
I swell my throat to warn you.
I puff myself up and my colors brighten.
It hurts; I burrow under a leaf.
I hop behind a stone.
There's a mark on my skin.
My throat swells and subsides.

lines.zh: 毒黏液被撞出来，我翻了身。
lines.en: My poison slime knocked loose, I flip over.
I press to the wet mud, gasping.
A small patch of my color has dulled.
That crushed the leaf I was on.
My slime makes poison darts.
I need deeper fern cover.
An insect has landed nearby.

lines.zh: 你把那点东西放到叶上。
lines.en: You set it on the leaf.
I move to a nearer leaf.
I can see that tiny movement.
A little bug settles on the leaf vein.
One more hop is all.
It's moving. Good.
I've pressed myself lower.

lines.zh: 那点东西的甜味，我闻到了。
lines.en: I catch the sweetness of that morsel.

lines.zh: 毒镖的射程，我算得很清。
lines.en: I know the dart's range exactly.

lines.zh: 我从你的指缝里滑了出去。
lines.en: I slip out between your fingers.
I hop past your shoe.
I'm toxic. Don't squeeze.

lines.zh: 我这么小，黏液却能冻住你。
lines.en: Small as I am, my slime can freeze you.

lines.zh: 我落在你的鞋带上，翻了身。
lines.en: I land on your shoelace and roll over.
You step on my leaf.

lines.zh: 我的黏液沾在你的鞋面上。
lines.en: My slime smears across your shoe.
That stuck me to your boot.
I crawl away slowly.
I hop back to the damp mud.

lines.zh: 我在你的手指上停了一瞬。
lines.en: I rest on your finger for an instant.

lines.zh: 我滑到你指甲边上，没掉。
lines.en: I slip to your nail's edge without falling.

lines.zh: 你抬脚，我被带起来一点。
lines.en: You lift your foot and I rise with it.
I flip over and crawl upright.
Another hops down beside me.
Our throats pulse together.
Its colors are deeper than mine.
We crouch on the same leaf.
It touches its foot to mine.
We call, one after the other.
It climbs slowly onto my back.
There's enough damp here for us.
Two small things, one leaf.
The rain comes, and we stay still.
I snap up the insect.
One flick of my tongue and the bug is gone.

lines.zh: 我把它推下叶子，看它落地。
lines.en: I shove it off the leaf and watch it fall.
I sweep it to your boot.

lines.zh: 我用前脚按住它，试试重量。
lines.en: I press it with a forefoot to test its weight.
The bug sinks in the water; I wait.

lines.zh: 这虫子比我的嘴宽太多。
lines.en: That bug is far wider than my mouth.
I leave it on the leaf.
That's plenty for me.
I swallow it a bit at a time.

lines.zh: 我的黏液让叶子微微发亮。
lines.en: My slime makes the leaf gleam faintly.
I puff myself up.
My colors have brightened.
I press myself flatter still.
I hop toward you slowly.
Reach over here again.
One touch will numb your hand.
I'll remember your boots.
I crouch on the stone facing you.

lines.zh: 我的后腿收紧了，对着你。
lines.en: My hind legs coil, aimed at you.
Poison sits on my skin.

lines.zh: 你走到哪，我换一片叶子。
lines.en: Wherever you go, I change leaves.
I'm on the fern by your feet.
I'm not fast, but I'm small.

lines.zh: 每一片叶子都是我的路。
lines.en: Every leaf is a road to me.
I wait for you to stoop.
My skin glows in the dark.
I count the leaves you step on.
One more step and I jump.
It's damp; my feet hold.
I bump the back of your hand.
That little strength is nothing.
My skin brushed you.
You pulled your hand back.
I spring back onto a leaf.
I land on your sleeve.
Your hand is going numb, isn't it?
I tumble onto a leaf.
Still at your feet. One hop.

lines.zh: 我撞在你指节上，留下黏液。
lines.en: I hit your knuckle and leave slime behind.

lines.zh: 一片叶子上多了点颜色。
lines.en: A bit of color appears on a leaf.

lines.zh: 雨停在叶上，我爬出来晒。
lines.en: Rain beads on the leaves; I crawl out to sit.
It's very damp here. Just right.
I crouch on a wet stone.
The rain just stopped, and I'm out.
I hop twice, finding my spot.

lines.zh: 蕨叶下多了一团红色的湿皮。
lines.en: A wet red shape appears under the fern.
I stop in the leaf litter.
A fleck of brightness joins the forest.
I settle down and go still.

lines.zh: 火一靠近，我的皮就干了。
lines.en: Fire nears and my skin dries.

lines.zh: 我从叶子上摔下去，翻了半圈。
lines.en: I fall off the leaf and flip over.
The water is too deep; I can't swim up.
The blast throws me onto a fern.

lines.zh: 箭擦过我的背，毒液还在。
lines.en: The arrow grazed my back; venom still drips.
The spell tightens my skin.
There are no insects left here.
Lightning flashes and I drop off the leaf.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有蕨叶，我直直落下。
lines.en: No ferns in the void; I fall straight down.
